profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Unbroken Studios
profile.summary:
I make video games -- I want to produce and tell stories that players will bond over for years. Be it the story that the game tells the players or the story that the players tell each other, there's always a narrative in video games; and I'm passionate about that narrative.

I'm a generalist video game developer who is eager to fulfill any requirements that the team and the project have. From bespoke tools for content creation, gameplay logic and behavior, optimizing street lights in an open world game, scheduling NPC's on dates, and even performing motion capture animation!

I'm there for the game and I love it.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Keywords: C++, Lua Scripting, Lumberyard, Tools Development, Gameplay Programming, Multiplayer, Network Programming, UI/UX

• Developed video games collaboratively as part of a team, performing primarily as a gameplay and UI/UX programmer.
• Created tools for effective and efficient content integration in games, working closely with artists and designers to custom-fit the tools to their and the project's needs.
• Designed and implemented entire gameplay systems and features, with written comprehensive technical documentation.
• Contributed improvements and fixes to the Lumberyard game engine.
• Performed motion capture animation.

positions.title: Unity Programmer
positions.description:
Keywords: C#, Unity, Tools Development, Level Design, Environment Art, Gameplay Programming

• Developed video games, performing primarily as a tools programmer.
• Created level design authoring tools, environment art integration tools, and other editor extensions for the Unity game engine.
• Worked on Assassin's Creed Rebellion

organizations.name: MakiSining: The Makiling Art Group
organizations.position: Founding Member, previously served as Molawin (Secretary) · Jul 2011 - Present
organizations.description: MakiSining: The Makiling Art Group is an artist collective of professional and non-professional visual artists in the vicinity of Mt. Makiling in Los Baños, Laguna, Philippines. The collective aims to push Mt. Makiling as the premier art capital of the Southern Tagalog Region, bringing to the limelight all the known and undiscovered artists in the area, and inviting a global audience.
